name: Filozofia - ďalšie slová B2
description: Odborná anglická slovná zásoba z oblasti filozofie
author: doc. Jana Nováková, PhD.

words.definition: A strong feeling that something is true.

examples.en: The teacher explained the term belief.
The debate focused on the concept of belief and its role in human decision-making.
examples.sk: Diskusia sa zamerala na pojem presvedčenie a jeho úlohu v rozhodovaní človeka.

contextSentences.en: A justified true belief was long considered the standard definition of knowledge until Gettier challenged it.
Philosophers distinguish between a belief one holds and a belief one is rationally entitled to hold.

words.example_en: The teacher explained the term belief.
words.example_sk: Učiteľ vysvetlil pojem presvedčenie.

words.definition: The idea or purpose that something expresses.

examples.en: This experiment shows how meaning works.
examples.sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje zmysel.

examples.en: The debate focused on the concept of meaning and its role in human decision-making.
examples.sk: Diskusia sa zamerala na pojem zmysel a jeho úlohu v rozhodovaní človeka.

contextSentences.en: According to Viktor Frankl, the search for meaning is the deepest driving force in human life.
Camus argued that life has no inherent meaning, but that we can create our own.

words.example_en: This experiment shows how meaning works.
words.example_sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje zmysel.

words.definition: The study of moral principles and what is right or wrong.
words.example_en: She studied ethics at university.
words.example_sk: Na univerzite študovala etiku.

words.definition: A cause or explanation for something; the ability to think, understand, and make judgments logically.
words.example_en: She gave a good reason for being late.
words.example_sk: Uviedla dobrý dôvod, prečo meškala.

words.definition: Fair treatment and the quality of being morally right and reasonable.
words.example_en: The court tried to ensure justice for all people involved.
words.example_sk: Súd sa snažil zabezpečiť spravodlivosť pre všetkých zúčastnených.

words.definition: Good moral behavior or a quality that is considered morally good.
words.example_en: Patience is often seen as a virtue.
words.example_sk: Trpezlivosť sa často považuje za cnosť.

words.definition: The ability to make good decisions based on knowledge, experience, and understanding.
words.example_en: Her wisdom helped the team solve the problem.
words.example_sk: Jej múdrosť pomohla tímu vyriešiť problém.

words.definition: The state of being free and able to act, speak, or think without unnecessary control or restriction.
words.example_en: Freedom of speech is an important right in many countries.
words.example_sk: Sloboda prejavu je v mnohých krajinách dôležitým právom.

words.definition: Information, understanding, and skills that you gain through experience or education.
words.example_en: She has a good knowledge of history.
words.example_sk: Má dobré znalosti z histórie.

words.definition: Principles or beliefs about what is right and wrong in human behavior.
words.example_en: The novel raises important questions about morality.
words.example_sk: Román nastoľuje dôležité otázky o morálke.

words.definition: The state of being aware of and able to think about yourself, your surroundings, and your experiences.
words.example_en: Doctors monitored the patient’s level of consciousness after the accident.
words.example_sk: Lekári po nehode sledovali pacientovu úroveň vedomia.

words.definition: The state of being real or living.
words.example_en: Scientists are studying the existence of life on other planets.
words.example_sk: Vedci skúmajú existenciu života na iných planétach.

words.definition: A basic truth, rule, or idea that guides behavior or explains how something works.
words.example_en: She refuses to lie because it is against her principles.
words.example_sk: Odmieta klamať, pretože je to proti jej zásadám.

words.definition: The characteristics, qualities, and beliefs that make a person or group different from others.
words.example_en: A person's identity can be shaped by culture, family, and experience.
words.example_sk: Identita človeka môže byť formovaná kultúrou, rodinou a skúsenosťami.

words.definition: A feeling of uncertainty or lack of confidence about something; to feel uncertain about something.
words.example_en: I doubt that he will arrive on time.
words.example_sk: Pochybujem, že príde načas.

words.definition: The way in which something is understood, interpreted, or noticed through the senses or the mind.
words.example_en: Our perception of reality can be influenced by emotions and past experiences.
words.example_sk: Naše vnímanie reality môže byť ovplyvnené emóciami a minulými skúsenosťami.

words.definition: Based on reason, logic, or clear thinking rather than emotion.
words.example_en: She made a rational decision after considering all the facts.
words.example_sk: Po zvážení všetkých faktov urobila racionálne rozhodnutie.

words.definition: Existing as an idea, feeling, or quality rather than as a material object; also, a short summary of a text or article.
words.example_en: Beauty is an abstract concept, and I read the abstract before the full article.
words.example_sk: Krása je abstraktný pojem a pred celým článkom som si prečítal zhrnutie.

words.definition: Based on personal feelings, opinions, or experiences rather than facts.
words.example_en: Taste in music is often subjective.
words.example_sk: Vkus v hudbe je často subjektívny.

words.definition: To throw back light, heat, or sound from a surface; to think carefully about something.
words.example_en: The mirror reflects the light, and later she reflected on what he had said.
words.example_sk: Zrkadlo odráža svetlo a neskôr premýšľala o tom, čo povedal.

words.definition: In a way that is reasonable, clear, and based on correct thinking or facts.
words.example_en: She explained the problem logically and clearly.
words.example_sk: Vysvetlila problém logicky a jasne.

words.definition: The ability to make your own choices and decisions independently.
words.example_en: Some philosophers argue that free will is essential for moral responsibility.
words.example_sk: Niektorí filozofi tvrdia, že slobodná vôľa je nevyhnutná pre morálnu zodpovednosť.
